name: 16VLR supernova survey field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward 16VLR, a target of the SUSHI supernova survey, seen by Hubble.
label: 16vlr-hubble
story: Hubble returned to this patch of sky as part of SUSHI, a search for faint, distant Type Ia supernovae first caught by Subaru's Hyper Suprime-Cam. Somewhere in the field, among the far galaxies, lies the target the survey came to follow.

claims.text: 16VLR is a target of Hubble program 14808, SUbaru Supernovae with Hubble Infrared (SUSHI)
16VLR is also a target of the follow-on SUSHI program 15363
SUSHI studies high-redshift Type Ia supernovae with light curves from Subaru Hyper Suprime-Cam plus Hubble WFC3/IR data
The program aims to discover and study high-quality Type Ia supernovae
